subject: Cross-border invoice creation: sender authorization, VAT tags, and delivery channel agreement
messages:
From: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@evergrove.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@evergrove.com
Cc: ap@evergrove.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Question: how will Redwood issue invoices across our EU/US entities?

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well — we kicked off procurement for the Q3 deployment and I need to confirm how Redwood will issue invoices for our multi-entity contract. A few specific items we need to lock down:

- Will Redwood emit invoices from a single Redwood entity or can they be created per Redwood customer entity so we can apply EU VAT/ reverse-charge logic correctly?
- For EU invoices we need UBL/UBL-like e-invoice fields (VAT registration, tax point, reverse-charge flags). Can you provide a sample XML schema?
- Preferred delivery channel: our AP team would like the option to receive signed SFTP pushes (for automated ingestion) or enroll in your billing portal. Some of our EU vendors require digital invoice receipts in a structured format; others will accept a PDF copy by email.
- Do you support sending an email copy to accounts-payable in addition to a portal push? Any constraints on attachments or file naming conventions?

Attached is our AP ingestion spec (high level). Please advise next steps and what we should provide from our side (billing contacts, remit-to, PO format).

Thanks,
Sandra Liu
Director, Finance Operations
Evergrove Systems

Attachment: evergrove_ap_spec_v1.pdf (referenced)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@evergrove.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: how will Redwood issue invoices across our EU/US entities?

Hi Sandra — thanks for the clear spec and questions. Short answer: we can support a hybrid approach that meets your AP intake and VAT tagging needs. Below is a concise proposal and the files I promised.

Attachments: redwood_invoicing_matrix.xlsx, evergrove_sample_einvoice.xml

Summary of options we recommend:
1) EU (entity-level, e-invoice): Primary = Redwood portal e-invoice (XML/UBL push) or SFTP signed transmission to your ingestion endpoint. This preserves structured VAT fields (vat_number, vat_status, tax_point, reverse_charge_flag).
2) US (non-VAT): Primary = PDF invoice by email (accounts-payable@evergrove.com) and optional portal copy.
3) Canary rollout: month 1 — email PDF copies + portal visibility; month 2 — switch EU invoices to portal/SFTP primary with email copies retained for 30 days.

Action items we need from Evergrove to finish onboarding:
- Confirm remit-to legal entity name(s) and VAT IDs per jurisdiction
- Provide the AP ingest endpoint (SFTP host + key) OR confirm portal enrollment admin account
- Clarify PO number placement (invoice header vs line-level) and any required PO prefix

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min technical handoff tomorrow to review the XML sample and mapping.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Billing Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
Olga's contact: olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: internal: Evergrove VAT mapping / channel approach

Folks — quick internal note before the call: Evergrove looks like a multi-entity customer (US + EU). A few operational flags to keep in mind: 

- For EU reverse-charge we must include both supplier_vat and customer_vat in the XML and set reverse_charge_indicator. Our current UBL exports have a "taxCategory" field that maps cleanly, but we should confirm Evergrove's exact tag names (their spec uses "vat_code").
- Routing: if they enroll the portal, invoices should still be able to be routed to different remit destinations depending on the billed entity. That means per-invoice metadata must include customer_entity_id.
- PO handling: recommend we require a PO on every invoice for the first two billing periods to avoid AP rejects. If they can't supply POs, we'll send a monthly statement for recon.
- Edge cases: if their EU AP needs signed-sftp only (no webhook), engineering will need 3–5 business days to provision a signed key + host setup.

I'll prepare a mapping checklist (vat tag mapping, currency handling, entity_id) and ask Priyom to validate with Legal if we need to add a clause for reverse-charge evidence retention.

Thanks,
Kim

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@evergrove.com>, accounts-payable@evergrove.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: how will Redwood issue invoices across our EU/US entities? — proposed plan and MAP

Hi Sandra — following up with a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so procurement/AP can confirm quickly. We attached the sample XML and our recommended mapping matrix.

Proposed channel and VAT handling (summary):
- EU entity invoices: structured XML e-invoice pushed to your ingestion endpoint (SFTP preferred) or delivered via Redwood billing portal. XML will include fields: supplier_vat_number, customer_vat_number, tax_point_date, reverse_charge_indicator, and entity_id.
- US entity invoices: PDF invoice delivered by email to accounts-payable@evergrove.com. Portal visibility will be enabled for both entities.
- Email copies: yes, we will send a PDF email copy to your AP address for every invoice regardless of channel for the first 60 days.

Mutual action plan (MAP):
1) You share remit-to names, VAT IDs, and the AP ingest endpoint (SFTP host + username + key) OR confirm portal admin invite email — due: 2025-05-14
2) Redwood provides: XML schema + sample files (attached), SFTP public key for provisioning, and a proposed canary date — due: 2025-05-15
3) Canary start: 2025-05-20 — for 4 weeks we run hybrid (email copies + portal/SFTP). After the canary period, we flip EU invoices to portal as primary.

Notes / exceptions:
- If Evergrove requires line-level PO placement we will validate with Billing Systems; we may need a one-time remapping with a small configuration fee.
- We will retain evidence for reverse-charge on request for 7 years; Priyom will follow up with Legal on the paperwork needed.

Attachments: evergrove_sample_einvoice.xml, redwood_invoicing_matrix.xlsx, mup_signed_authorization.pdf

Please confirm the AP contact(s) and whether PO is required on every invoice. If that works, I'll send a DocuSign for the SFTP authorization and schedule the technical handoff.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, Billing Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
Olga Petrov | olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@evergrove.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@evergrove.com, ap@evergrove.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: how will Redwood issue invoices across our EU/US entities? — proposed plan and MAP

Thanks, Olga — this looks good. We accept the hybrid approach and can confirm the following: 

- AP ingest endpoint (SFTP): sftp.evergrove.com (will share an onboarding user + public key separately)
- Remit entities and VAT IDs: Evergrove US (EIN 12-3456789), Evergrove EU Ltd (VAT GB999999999)
- AP contacts: accounts-payable@evergrove.com (sync inbox) and Sandra Liu (sandra.liu@evergrove.com) for escalations
- PO requirement: PO number required on invoice header for all transactions (we will supply prefix EVG- in the PO)

We will review the XML sample and return any field-level notes by EOD tomorrow. Please go ahead and send the DocuSign for SFTP authorization and invite our portal admin (ap@evergrove.com).

Thanks,
Sandra
